subject: CS: instrumentation & rollback playbook for Helio go-live
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@heliohealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@heliohealth.com
Date: 2029-05-02T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Go-live: canary / rollback expectations and instrumentation needs

Hi Stephanie and Monica,

Thanks again for the onboarding sessions last week — the team at Helio is excited to move to the production endpoint on May 15. Before we flip the switch we need a clear, tested plan for:

- Canary rollout schedule and traffic split (how do we phase users in?)
- Observable signals that qualify a canary as healthy (latency, 4xx/5xx, hallucination regressions on sample prompts)
- Automated rollback criteria and the mechanized steps to execute it
- How the eval harness will be wired to our sandbox so we can surface regression alerts during the canary

Can you share the artifacts you normally hand off for this (matrix, runbook, and any acceptance criteria)? Also attaching our internal ops checklist — we’d like the deployment to be scripted as much as possible so our SREs can trigger rollback without deep product knowledge.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Park
Head of ML Ops, Helio Health
sam.park@heliohealth.com

Attachment: helio_ops_checklist_MAY2029.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Go-live: canary / rollback expectations and instrumentation needs

Sam —

Great context, thanks. High level plan below and I’ve looped in Marissa to own the eval/harness integration details. We’ll deliver a short playbook + a canary/rollback matrix by EOD Thursday (May 9).

Planned deliverables:
- Canary & rollback matrix (spreadsheet): traffic split, monitoring thresholds, responsible owners, estimated RTO
- Eval harness integration notes: how we wire Helio sandbox to our eval runner, cadence for automated regressions, sample prompt sets
- Runbook (markdown): step-by-step rollback, verification checks post-rollback, doc links for SRE runbook

Immediate asks for Helio (so we can finalize thresholds):
1) A set of 50 representative prompt templates you want included in the regression suite
2) Target SLOs for 95th/99th latency and acceptable top-level error rate

Next steps:
- Marissa will schedule a 30-minute working session with your ML team tomorrow to walk integration hooks.
- We’ll share a draft matrix and runbook for your review by 2029-05-09.

If this timeline is too tight, say so and we’ll adjust.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@heliohealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Go-live: canary / rollback expectations and instrumentation needs

Hi Sam, Stephanie —

Quick note ahead of tomorrow’s working session: on the eval harness side we propose the following integration pattern so you can get automated regression alerts during canary traffic.

Integration pattern (recommended):
- Mirror a 1% sample of canary traffic to an isolated Helm sandbox where the eval harness runs (no PII persisted)
- Run daily batch evals against the 50+ prompt templates, plus a continuous streaming scoring job for high-priority prompts
- For each eval run compute: accuracy/expected-answer match (where applicable), NER hallucination score, and a custom safety score
- If any metric crosses the configured threshold for two consecutive runs OR the streaming scorer spikes by >X%, fire a regression alert to Helio SRE Slack + Redmine ticket

Technical hooks we need from Helio:
- Sandbox endpoint URL and API key (read-only)
- A sample of the 50 prompts in CSV (template + acceptance criteria column)
- Contact for SRE (ops@heliohealth.com is fine)

I’ll attach the eval_harness_integration_notes.md and a skeleton scoring config to the draft playbook. During tomorrow’s call we can walk the scoring thresholds; happy to start with conservative settings and loosen after two successful canary days.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: eval_harness_integration_notes.md (text/markdown)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@heliohealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-06T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: Canary & rollback matrix + runbook (for review)

Team —

Attached are the draft artifacts we discussed:
- canary_rollback_matrix_v1.xlsx (matrix with traffic split options and automated trigger columns)
- mutual_action_plan_MAY2029.pdf (timeline & owner RACI)
- eval_harness_integration_notes.md (Marissa’s document integrated into the playbook)

Highlights and conservative defaults we recommend:
- Day 0-1: 1% traffic canary, 15-min latency sampling, trigger if 95th > 1.8s OR error rate > 0.5%
- Day 2-3: ramp to 5% if canary is green; automated checks run every 4 hours
- Regression alert policy: two consecutive eval runs breaching threshold OR streaming scorer spike > 30% => auto-pause traffic to canary and notify
- Manual rollback window: SRE can execute scripted rollback from our Console UI (Steps 1–5 in runbook). We will provide the runbook command snippets and a short run-through on the call.

Please review the spreadsheet and the scoring thresholds. Key open items for Helio to confirm:
1) Acceptance criteria column for each prompt (we need a description for any prompt that has a subjective pass/fail)
2) Approval to mirror 1% of traffic to the sandbox (data handling confirmation)

We can iterate quickly — if I don’t hear edits from Helio by EOD Monday (2029-05-06) we’ll treat this as the baseline and schedule a dry-run.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Attachments: canary_rollback_matrix_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), mutual_action_plan_MAY2029.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Sam Park <sam.park@heliohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-06T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Canary & rollback matrix + runbook (for review)

Monica —

This looks great and exactly what we needed. Quick answers:
- We’ll provide the 50 prompt templates + acceptance criteria CSV by Friday (2029-05-10).
- Ops is OK with the 1% mirror for the sandbox (they confirmed no PII will be forwarded).
- SRE would like the scripted rollback steps in a single script we can run; if you can include that in the runbook we’ll test in our staging environment next week.

Please treat this as acknowledgement — we approve the draft thresholds and matrix pending the prompt CSV. Let’s schedule a short dry-run on 2029-05-13 to validate the rollback script.

Sam
Head of ML Ops, Helio Health
sam.park@heliohealth.com
